locale.message: JMEF XML Generator

The plugin extends the basic metadata for the journal to enable the creation of XML in the Journal Metadata Exchange Format (JMEF). The metadata can be filled in the plugin settings after it is activated. The generated XML address will be [journal URL]/jmef (e.g. https://ojs.yourjournal.com/jmef)
Review type
Choose type of your review process from the list
Journal's DOI
Fill in the journal's DOI in the format 10.xxxx/xxxx (e.g. 10.1234/abcdefgh)
Journal's DDH ID
If the journal is in DDH, please enter the DDH ID number.
Journal's DOAJ ID
If the journal is in DOAJ, please enter the DOAJ ID number.
Publisher location
You have filled this publisher name in the settings: {$publisherName}
Select the country where the publisher is based.
Journal keywords
Enter keywords describing your journal, separated by ;

Check if you have open authorship.
(self-declaration text defined by DDH regarding openness to all authors will appear at the end of the About page.)
Journal policy
Diamond criteria
Additional Journal Metadata
Other organisations
The owner of the journal, if it is different from the publisher, or other organisations associated with the journal, separated by ;
OECD 2007 Classification
Choose your journal's classification from the list.
Check if your journal could be classified as Scholarly journal.

Check if your journal is community owned.
(self-declaration text about ownership defined by DDH will appear at the end of the About page.)
Check if your journal has no APCs and any kind of subscriptions to it's content.
Choose the type of your institution/organisation:
public
not-for-profit

Open to all authors:

{$contextTitle} is committed to openness and inclusivity in scholarly publishing without author-facing charges for reading or publishing. We welcome submissions from all authors, regardless of their institutional affiliation, geographical location, or academic status. Submissions only must align with the aims and scope of the journal and meet the required quality standards once the reviewing process is completed.

Community-owned:

{$contextTitle} is owned by {$publisherInstitution}, a {$organisationType} institution/organisation dedicated to advancing research and scholarship. The journal’s ownership and governance structure reflect its mission to support open and accessible academic publishing. We confirm that any commercial service providers involved in our operations only deal with service-related aspects of journal publishing. All content-related aspects of publishing, such as submission, peer review, acceptance, publication frequency, and scope of the journal, are controlled by the editors / the owners of the journal.
